# Volunteer handbook

This is the working guide for opening the community workshop. The alarm code is kept on the physical card inside the secure key box, never in this notebook. Open the shutter, check the floor for water, turn on the lights and leave the exit path clear. If anything looks unsafe, keep the room closed and phone the duty contact.

The compliance training session covers fire exits and safe tool handling. It does not make any volunteer responsible for diagnosing every electrical fault. Ask Jo before lending equipment whose inspection label is missing. A damaged tool belongs in the red tray with a short description of the problem. Visitors can wait at the bench, but should not wait indefinitely without an explanation. [[Maintenance]] is where we keep repair decisions; this page should stay useful during an interrupted shift.
